Notes for finance:

- Remit format: we support two options: (A) single-line CSV with columns (invoice_id, amount, po_number, remit_reference) or (B) ACH addenda with structured remit in the N/94 line. Aditya, SparkBridge asked specifically about CSV.

A few confirmations from our side:
- Preferred remit: CSV single-line (invoice_id, amount, po_number, remit_reference). We will include PO# on every invoice.
- Remit reference field should accept up to 40 characters (we will put PO+invoice short id).
- Please confirm Redwood's payee name on file: SparkBridge Logistics LLC (EIN on W-9 matches).
